# =============================================================================
# UPDATED robots.txt — 2026-10-15
# Changes vs 2026-04-22 version:
#   - Removed the trailing "$" from every asset Allow rule. WordPress loads
#     CSS/JS with a version string (e.g. layout.min.css?ver=8.1), so "$" never
#     matched and Googlebot was blocked from 268 render-critical files
#     (jQuery, Enfold CSS, avia.min.js, Perfmatters lazyload.min.js).
#   - Added Allow rules for CSS/JS inside /wp-includes/.
#   - Added image + font Allow rules for /wp-content/plugins/.
#   - Added .webp, .ico, .ttf, .otf, .eot to theme asset Allows.
#   - Removed the old commented-out pre-April block.
# Folder Disallows stay in place, so PHP files remain blocked: Google applies
# the most specific (longest) matching rule, so the Allow lines win only for
# the asset files.
# =============================================================================
 
User-agent: *
 
# --- WordPress core ---
Disallow: /wp-admin/
Disallow: /wp-includes/
Disallow: /wp-login.php
Disallow: /wp-register.php
Disallow: /xmlrpc.php
Disallow: /wp-cron.php
Disallow: /readme.html
Allow: /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php
Allow: /wp-includes/*.css
Allow: /wp-includes/*.js
 
# --- Themes & plugins: block PHP, allow static assets for rendering ---
Disallow: /wp-content/themes/
Disallow: /wp-content/plugins/
Allow: /wp-content/themes/*.css
Allow: /wp-content/themes/*.js
Allow: /wp-content/themes/*.png
Allow: /wp-content/themes/*.jpg

# --- Logs, backups, and internal directories ---
Disallow: /wp-content/debug.log
Disallow: /wp-content/autosignup-log/
Disallow: /wp-content/webtoffee_iew_log/

# --- Test / demo / internal files ---
Disallow: /test/
Disallow: /demo-*
Disallow: /testIp.php
Disallow: /ttfb.html
 
# --- Referral, tracking, and low-value query strings ---
Disallow: /refer/
Disallow: /trackback/
Disallow: /?utm
Disallow: /*?s=
Disallow: /*?replytocom=
Disallow: /*?rest_route=
Disallow: /*?attachment_id=

Disallow: /*?preview_id=
 
# --- MailPoet ---
Disallow: /*?mailpoet_page=captcha
Disallow: /*?mailpoet_page=subscriptions
 
# --- Feeds ---
Disallow: /*/feed/?attachment_id=
Disallow: /feed/?attachment_id=
